title: Neon plans - Neon Docs
description: Compare Neon's Free, Launch, and Scale plans: compute rates ($0.106/CU-hour on Launch, $0.222/CU-hour on Scale), storage ($0.35/GB-month, unlimited on paid plans), branch and project limits, autoscaling, and Free plan allowances. Paid plans have no monthly minimum. Includes billing examples for estimating costs.
